assignmentTitle: Comparative Study and Selection of Springs for Engineering Applications

criteria.title: Observe Springs in Real Applications
criteria.description: Understanding client brief, real-world spring applications, and project scope.

criteria.title: Identify the Four Spring Configurations
criteria.description: Accurate labeling of helical compression spring, extension spring, concentric springs, leaf spring, and mounting hardware on EA-14.

criteria.title: Identify Application and Function
criteria.description: Correct matching of spring arrangements with their intended mechanical applications and functional purposes.

criteria.title: Compare Loading Conditions
criteria.description: Comparing primary internal stress states (torsional shear in wire vs flexural bending in leaves).

criteria.title: Compare Construction and Geometry
criteria.description: Understanding geometric features, opposite helix winding in concentric springs, and leaf laminations.

criteria.title: Compare Design Requirements
criteria.description: Comparing operating frequency, space constraints, surge avoidance, and load capacity requirements.

criteria.title: Compare Performance, Advantages and Limitations
criteria.description: Evaluating fail-safe redundancy, hook stress concentrations, and inter-leaf friction trade-offs.

criteria.title: Engineering Trade-Off
criteria.description: Analyzing complex engineering scenarios and selecting optimal spring configurations.

criteria.title: Select the Appropriate Spring
criteria.description: Selecting and justifying spring arrangements for transfer applications based on functional requirements.

criteria.title: Comparative Engineering Recommendation
criteria.description: Synthesizing concise comparative recommendation report covering spring classification, selection matrix, and maintenance insights.
